changes: Removed auto sync credentials feature to prevent accidental overwriting of credentials and ensure that users have full control over their authentication settings.
Fixed the template for uploads
Updated zoom token secret token to fix webhook verification issues.
Fixed a bug for updating app_config.json version number in the app's UI, ensuring that the displayed version accurately reflects the current configuration version.
Added a new feature to display the app_config.json version number in the app's UI, providing users with clear visibility of the configuration version they are currently using.
Implemented a new feature to automatically check for updates to the app_config.json file on startup, ensuring that users always have
Added configuration version management with semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) to app_config.json for controlled deployments and multi-instance synchronization.

Implemented automatic sync system that downloads app_config.json, secrets.env, zoom_token.json, google_credentials.json, and oauth_credentials.json from Google Drive on startup with smart version comparison.
Added automatic backup of all configuration files to Google Drive, ensuring no configuration changes are lost and enabling seamless multi-instance deployments.

Fixed critical bugs: infinite retry loop in ClickUp sync (won't proceed with incomplete data), stream re-consumption in file uploads, and stream handle leaks in download loop preventing 'Too many open files' crashes.
Improved file size validation with tolerance-based checking (1% or 1MB) instead of exact match, fixing false-positive file corruption errors due to network padding.
Implemented continuous backup system - completed_log.json now backs up to Google Drive immediately after each video is processed, preventing data loss on app crashes.
Enhanced bot stop message to display 'Manual Override' when user stops the bot manually, providing clear feedback on stop status versus error codes.
Suppressed punycode deprecation warnings from googleapis library for cleaner console output.
Added better error handling for bugs
Make the logs errors more specific for bug reporting

Hotfix: Edited Logo name font.

Added a Light and Dark Mode theme toggle for better user experience and accessibility. Users can now switch between light and dark themes based on their preference, making the app more visually appealing and easier to use in different lighting conditions.

Updated the app icon to a new design that better represents the brand and enhances the overall look of the application. The new icon provides a fresh and modern appearance, making it more recognizable and appealing to users.

Updated the Design to be more modern and sleek, improving the overall user interface and user experience. The new design features a cleaner layout, improved typography, and a more intuitive navigation system, making it easier for users to interact with the app and access its features.
Fixed a bug where files failed to upload properly cause of difference in zoom file size and actual downloaded file size.
Fixed update timer logic.
Added try and catch logic for small size difference for txt and vtt files
New icon hell yeah!

Added a new feature to automatically check for updates every 30 minutes and notify the user when an update is available. This ensures that users always have the latest version of the app with the newest features and bug fixes.
Added a new feature to safely save data to prevent file corruption. This ensures that user data is protected and reduces the risk of losing important information due to unexpected crashes or errors.
Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash when reading clickup brands. This improves the stability of the app and ensures that users can access their clickup brands without any issues.
